text_block_list.text: Returning to the front of the station, I ran into Cesario and the others holding shopping bags.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat!? It's so unfair you three are going out together!
I wanna hang out too!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu. Oh no, it wasn't for fun.
I just finished running an errand for the dorm mother.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Then let's go hang out now!
You come too, Trainer! Pretty please? Huh?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Even if I say no, you won't listen, will you?
Good grief, I guess I have no choice.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! Let's drop off our bags first,
and then go hang out together properly!

She's been working hard at her training lately.
...In that case, let's make today all about doing whatever she wants.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
“—Time for the third song!
I'm not letting go of this mic yet~♡”

Clapping along to the music,
I watch over her, thinking she's really going all out.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ngaah~! I sang my heart out ♡
My throat's bone dry...

text_block_list.name: Karaoke Clerk
text_block_list.text:
—Pardon me.
I have brought your carrot juice.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ? Who could this belong to?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ah! I wanna drink that!
I just finished mine off a second ago.
choice_data_list: It's yours, Pandora. I ordered it earlier.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Ah, for real? That's a lifesaver~♡

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Waaah! Trainer's read was spot-on!
You're amazing, Pandora-san!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Huh? Well, maybe so~♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Now that I've tried it on,
maybe baby pink would've been better after all~?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Hey, hey~ Bring over that first one we looked at~.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
You've been holding onto that this whole time?
...You're pretty used to this, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. You're very good at providing support.
I'm learning a lot ♪

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Well, you are the trainer of the genius Pandora-chan, after all!
This much is only natural~♡"

text_block_list.name: Family Restaurant Waiter
text_block_list.text: ...Will that be all for your order?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? Trainer,
did you order anything for yourself?
choice_data_list: Ah, no. But I think it'll probably be fine.
No, but I think it'll be fine.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ah~ that was delicious♡ I want some parfait too, so
I'll give the rest to y-o-u♡

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
P-Pandora's Trainer is
really amazing... They see right through everything.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Oh, stop it, you're making me blush~♡♡

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Huh? Where is Pandora-san's Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Hm?
Said she's gonna go check if I left anything behind~

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Pandora-san's Trainer
is truly so thoughtful and attentive.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Oh, yeah? You're my Trainer, so isn't this pretty much normal?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: "Normal", huh...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
You should show some gratitude once in a while.
Once they get fed up with you, it'll be too late.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I am, I totally am♡ Suuuuper doing it♡
...Right, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Sorry to keep you waiting... wait, what are you talking about?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Hmm~?
Just sayin' "thanks for everything~ mwah♡"♡♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
So, where to next~?
Pick somewhere nice for us♡
choice_data_list: Go to a classic photo-worthy spot
Go to the popular obstacle course park

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: “—How's it look? Pretty neat, right?”

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Alright, I'm taking it now.
—Say cheese!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
All right! Next, I'll take a photo with King-senpai!
And then with Cesario-chan!
choice_data_list: Are you planning to take a photo with everyone?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Of course!
...A-And with you, too! Big heart♡
choice_data_list: ...Well then, maybe I'll go buy some drinks.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Ah! Hey, don't run away!

text_block_list.name: Pandora & King
text_block_list.text:
—Wait, it's a haunted house~~!?
—Wait, isn't it a haunted house!?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Horror and obstacle courses... That's quite an interesting combination♪
choice_data_list: It's like an escape adventure game.
It's like an escape adventure game.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Looks like it," my foot!
You dummy! Idiot!
You know I hate ghosts~~~~!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Looks like it," my foot!
You dummy! Idiot!
You know I hate ghosts~~~~!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"I'm not opening my eyes until we're outside!
You'd better take responsibility and lead me out, okay!?"
